name: Waypoint b1
navigationPrompt: Head north on Upper Woburn Place.
contextualPrompt: Head north on Upper Woburn Place via the few descending steps. St Pancras New Church is located on your right. The church is a prominent historic landmark in this part of Bloomsbury.

name: Waypoint b2
navigationPrompt: Cross Euston Road using the staggered crossing, then cross Eversholt Street on the left and turn right to continue.
contextualPrompt: Cross Euston Road using the staggered crossing, then cross Eversholt Street on the left and turn right to continue. A bus depot also connects with this street at the signalled crossing coming up on your left.

name: Waypoint b3
navigationPrompt: Turn left and proceed to Euston Station forecourt.
contextualPrompt: Turn left and proceed to Euston Station forecourt via the ascending steps. You are entering Euston Station, one of London's principal railway and underground stations, dominated by a high level of pedestrian density.

name: Waypoint b4
navigationPrompt: Continue through Euston Station forecourt and then turn left to use the south exit.
contextualPrompt: Continue through Euston Station forecourt and then turn left to use the south exit. Follow the outer shoreline on your right to avoid seating and complex pedestrian movement. Pass the station entrance and commerce before turning left onto the path leading south.

name: Waypoint b5
navigationPrompt: Continue along the path turning East along the Euston Road.
contextualPrompt: Continue along the path turning East along the Euston Road. A taxi rank is located on your right. University College Hospital is located in this area.

name: Waypoint b6
navigationPrompt: Cross Melton Street and then turn left to cross Euston Road.
contextualPrompt: Cross Melton Street and then turn left to cross Euston Road. The Melton Street crossing is staggered and signalled. The Euston Road crossing is unsignalled. This is a major transport corridor with high traffic volumes and continuous pedestrian movement.

name: Waypoint b7
navigationPrompt: Cross Euston Road and continue south on Gordon Street.
contextualPrompt: Cross Euston Road and continue south on Gordon Street. This area is surrounded by UCL buildings and student services.

name: Waypoint b8
contextualPrompt: Continue south on Gordon Street. This street has a contemporary design with wide pedestrian areas, trees and distinctive paving that differs from surrounding streets.

name: Waypoint b9
navigationPrompt: Turn left to continue east along Gordon Square.
contextualPrompt: Turn left to continue east along Gordon Square using the zebra crossing. This mixed-use street combines pedestrian space, seating, tables, planters and a cycleway within the same streetscape. Access to vehicles is prohibited.

name: Waypoint b10
navigationPrompt: Turn right to continue south along Gordon Square.
contextualPrompt: Turn right to continue south along Gordon Square. A cycleway intersects the corner and the proceeding footway is narrow.

name: Waypoint b11
navigationPrompt: Turn right to enter Gordon Square and follow the path to the south exit.
contextualPrompt: Turn right to enter Gordon Square and follow the path to the south exit. Follow the outer path to your left. This park contains several intersecting pathways with a shoreline route along the south, east and north side. The part is characterised by benches and open grass areas.

name: Waypoint b12
navigationPrompt: Exit Gorden Square and cross the road.
contextualPrompt: Exit Gorden Square and cross the road using the zebra crossing. This crossing is intersected by cycleways on either side.

name: Waypoint b13
navigationPrompt: Turn left into Woburn Square. Follow the path to your left to walk around the park clockwise back to the entrance.
contextualPrompt: Turn left into Woburn Square. Follow the path to your left to walk around the park clockwise back to the entrance. This is one of several historic garden squares in Bloomsbury, providing a quieter green space separated from surrounding streets. Benches are located around the edges with an open greenspace in the middle.

name: Waypoint b14
navigationPrompt: When exiting the park, turn left and continue straight.
contextualPrompt: When exiting the park, turn left and continue straight through Byng Place. This is a shared space where pedestrians and cyclists use the same area with fewer conventional street boundaries.

name: Waypoint b15
contextualPrompt: Continue straight. You are leaving the main UCL campus area and returning to a more conventional streetscape.

name: Waypoint b16
navigationPrompt: Turn right onto Gower Street and head north.
contextualPrompt: Turn right onto Gower Street and head north. This crossing is intersected by cycleways on either side.

name: Waypoint b17
navigationPrompt: The destination is on your right, UCL Gower Street.
contextualPrompt: The destination is on your right, UCL Gower Street. This is the main entrance of the university.
